notes.title: [Notice] Game Update - Improving the Game!
notes.notes:
Into the Rhythm VR has received a new patch

After a week of release, we have been listening to our user's voice and making changes to our game. While it doesn't include everything that we wish to change/upgrade about our game. We have includeed minor changes to the game and our tools to provide a better gaming experience.

Changes to the game

    All 20 songs will be unlocked from the beginning. It will not require you to score S level or above to unlock new songs.
    New drum sets will become available every 10 songs instead of 100. (Total of 6 drums)
    Mixed Reality support is now available.
    2D editor now allows you to include/upload your own personal drum sounds.
    Japanese language has been added.


Bug Fix

    Before: If you were below ranking 5, all your ranking were shown as 6th.
    Now: It will show your real ranking.


We are still working with features/support below to brining you new content in upcoming months

    Oculus SDK support
    2D Mode - Allowing you to play game without VR device
    New Songs
